episodeTitle.en: Scripts for navigating difficult conversations | Alisa Cohn (executive coach)
episodeTitle.zh: 应对艰难对话的剧本 | 阿莉莎·科恩（Alisa Cohn，执行教练）

guestBioOfficial.en: Alisa Cohn is an executive coach who has worked with C-suite executives at startups like Venmo, Etsy, Wirecutter, and DraftKings, and Fortune 500 companies like Microsoft, Google, Pfizer, Dell, and IBM. Inc. Magazine named Alisa one of the top 100 leadership speakers, and she was named one of the Top 50 coaches in the world by Thinkers50 and the #1 startup coach for the past four years by Global Gurus. She is also the author of From Start-Up to Grown-Up, which won the 2022 Independent Press Award and the American Book Fest 2023 Best Book Award for Entrepreneurship, and is the creator and host of a podcast of the same name. In our conversation, we discuss: • The psychology behind why we avoid difficult conversations
guestBioOfficial.zh:
艾丽莎·科恩（Alisa Cohn）是一位高管教练，曾与Venmo、Etsy、Wirecutter和DraftKings等初创公司的高管，以及微软、谷歌、辉瑞、戴尔和IBM等《财富》500强公司的C级高管合作。《Inc.》杂志将艾丽莎评为全球百位领导力演讲者之一，Thinkers50将她列为全球前50位教练，而Global Gurus则连续四年将她评为头号初创公司教练。她还著有《从初创到成熟》一书，该书荣获2022年独立出版社奖和2023年美国图书节创业类最佳图书奖，并创办了同名播客节目。在我们的对谈中，我们将探讨：  
• 我们为何回避艰难对话的心理机制

title.en: Scripts for navigating difficult conversations | Alisa Cohn (executive coach)
title.zh: 应对艰难对话的剧本 | 阿莉莎·科恩（Alisa Cohn，执行教练）

summary.en: Alisa shares specific language for having difficult conversations, such as delivering a tough “no promotion” message while preserving hope and the employee's growth. She pushes back on the idea that a leader's job is to make everyone happy, arguing that driving toward results sometimes requires uncomfortable feedback. The conversation also covers practical tactics for running more effective meetings and a simple three-question routine to close them well.
summary.zh: Alisa 分享了进行困难对话的具体话术，例如在告知“不予晋升”时如何保留希望与员工的成长空间。她反对“领导的工作是让所有人开心”的观念，认为达成结果有时需要让人不适的反馈。对话还包含让会议更高效的实用技巧，以及用三个问题漂亮收尾会议的方法。
